## BlackRock, Inc. (BLK) `[Asset Management]`
- BlackRock reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted EPS of $15.93 versus a $14.32 consensus estimate and revenue of $7.75 billion versus $7.42 billion expected; net inflows were $205 billion and assets under management reached $15.5 trillion. (MarketBeat, Oct 15, 2026) [4][7]
- Keefe, Bruyette & Woods raised its price target to $1,310 from $1,290 and maintained an Outperform rating, citing $175 billion of long-term inflows, 11% organic base-fee growth and a 47.8% operating margin versus its 45.8% estimate. (Investing.com, Oct 15, 2026) [6]
- Bank of America raised its price target to $1,313 from $1,287 and maintained a Buy rating after increasing its 2026–2028 EPS estimates. (Markets Insider, Oct 15, 2026) [2]
- JPMorgan raised its price target to $1,449 from $1,435 and maintained an Overweight rating after describing the third-quarter result as a “clean beat.” (Markets Insider, Oct 15, 2026) [3]
- Wells Fargo raised its price target to $1,250 from $1,230 and maintained an Overweight rating, citing base organic fee growth above its third-quarter forecast. (Markets Insider, Oct 15, 2026) [5]
- Barclays lowered its price target to $1,410 from $1,420 and maintained an Overweight rating, while describing the third-quarter report as strong. (Markets Insider, Oct 15, 2026) [1]
- BlackRock shares closed Thursday, October 15, at $1,100.40, up $26.61, or 4.80%, according to the verified tape and contemporaneous market coverage. (MarketBeat, Oct 15, 2026) [4]
- No after-hours or pre-market catalyst was identified in the available results through 02:03 ET on Friday, October 16, 2026.
